title: רב נתן בר אושעיא

paragraphs: Rav Natan bar Oshaya was not a tanna of a baraita; see the general rules. Nazir 51a has 'Rav Natan bar Oshaya taught.' Abaye found his colleagues, Nazir 44b. R. Ḥisda said: R. Natan bar Hoshaya said, Ḥullin 138a. He disagrees with Rav Yehudah: R. Yehudah says, R. Natan bar Oshaya says, Kiddushin 32a. He asked R. Yoḥanan, Shabbat 102b; Kiddushin 74b. Shabbat 81b: Hoshaya. Natan bar Hoshaya said: R. Yoḥanan said, Jerusalem Talmud, HaMaddir, halakhah 3. He objects to Shemuel, Gittin 18a. Yuḥasin also lists Naḥman bar Oshaya, derived from Shabbat 65a. She'erit Yosef lists that Naḥman among R. Yoḥanan's students. But Rif there reads Rav Natan bar Oshaya. This seems correct, since no other mention of Naḥman bar Oshaya occurs in the Shas; see Naḥman bar Ushpazti. R. Yehudah bar Ishtiti in his time.
